title: AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate (SAA-C03)
short_desc: Design secure, resilient, high-performing and cost-optimized architectures on AWS.
description: Prepare for the AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate (SAA-C03) exam. Lessons follow the four official domains with architecture patterns, service comparisons and scenario-based practice questions.
what_you_learn: Design secure access to AWS resources and secure workloads | Build resilient, highly available and decoupled architectures | Choose high-performing storage, compute, database and network solutions | Optimise cost across compute, storage, database and networking
requirements: Hands-on experience with AWS services is recommended | AWS Cloud Practitioner knowledge or equivalent
